# criblio_appscope_configs (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_appscope_configs" "example" {
  group_id = "default"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the AppScope Config.
- `lib` (String) Library metadata for the AppScope Config.
- `tags` (String) Tags associated with the AppScope Config.
